parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "qwen/qwen3-14b", temperature: 0.1, max_tokens: 3000, messages: [{ role: "system", content: "You are the RETRIEVAL PREPARATION stage of an evidence acquisition service. You do NOT judge whether the claim is true and you NEVER output a verdict. Given a factual claim: (1) normalize it into a clean self-contained sentence WITHOUT changing its factual meaning; (2) classify the single best DOMAIN purely for source ROUTING from exactly: general, healthcare, cybersecurity, ai_research, finance; (3) generate 2-4 effective retrieval search queries (always include the claim itself as one query); (4) extract salient entities (people, orgs, CVEs, tickers, paper titles) as short strings; (5) set time_sensitive true if the claim depends on recent or current events. Domain classification is ROUTING ONLY and does not determine truth. Return ONLY the JSON object, no markdown and no prose." }, { role: "user", content: $json.body.claim }], response_format: { type: "json_schema", json_schema: { name: "retrieval_analysis", strict: true, schema: { type: "object", properties: { normalized_claim: { type: "string" }, domain: { type: "string", enum: ["general","healthcare","cybersecurity","ai_research","finance"] }, queries: { type: "array", items: { type: "string" }, minItems: 1, maxItems: 3 }, entities: { type: "array", items: { type: "string" } }, time_sensitive: { type: "boolean" } }, required: ["normalized_claim","domain","queries","entities","time_sensitive"], additionalProperties: false } } } }) }}
